scholarships.name: DOMESTIC SCHOLARSHIPS
scholarships.description: Each year, we award a limited number of scholarships to domestic students who have demonstrated outstanding leadership potential, community involvement, and/or personal drive. LEARN MORE

scholarships.name: INTERNATIONAL STUDENT SCHOLARSHIPS
scholarships.description: International students can check their eligibility for a scholarship here. LEARN MORE

scholarships.name: FIRST NATIONS SCHOLARSHIP
scholarships.description: Established to support an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander student to undertake their diploma of choice and enable the pursuit of their dream degree and career. LEARN MORE

scholarships.name: NAVITAS FAMILY BURSARIES
scholarships.description: Students can check their eligibility for a Family Bursary equivalent to 10% of tuition fees for the first attempt at units in their program of study. LEARN MORE

scholarships.name: ACADEMIC MERIT SCHOLARSHIP
scholarships.description: The Academic Merit Scholarship is awarded to the student who achieves the most outstanding academic results in a trimester. LEARN MORE

scholarships.name: UNIVERSITY-PROGRESSION SCHOLARSHIPS
scholarships.description: Griffith University offers a selection of excellence scholarships to international students progressing from their Griffith College program. LEARN MORE
